column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rule overrides for the pizza-store DAST gate.
# Format: <pluginId>\t<IGNORE|WARN|FAIL>\t<optional url-regex>
# Consumed by the `ZAP baseline scan` step in .github/workflows/ci.yml via the
# `rules_file_name` input. Every IGNORE below is a deliberate, documented
# acceptance — the fixable findings (CSP, anti-clickjacking, nosniff,
# Permissions-Policy, COOP, CORP, SRI) are FIXED in code (SecurityHeadersFilter
# + Subresource-Integrity in index.html), not ignored. Re-evaluate on each ZAP
# stable-image bump; remove an entry if the underlying finding no longer fires.
# 10017 — Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion.
# The frontend loads jQuery (code.jquery.com), STOMP (cdn.jsdelivr.net) and
# Bootstrap (maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com) from pinned CDN URLs, each guarded with a
# Subresource-Integrity (sha384) hash + crossorigin="anonymous" so a tampered
# CDN payload is rejected by the browser. Pinned + SRI'd CDN inclusion is the
# project's established pattern; not a defect.
# 90004 — Insufficient Site Isolation Against Spectre (COEP/COOP/CORP).
# Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy and Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy ARE set
# (same-origin) by SecurityHeadersFilter; only Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy is
# intentionally omitted — require-corp would force every cross-origin CDN
# subresource to opt in via CORP and provides no benefit without
# cross-origin-isolation needs (no SharedArrayBuffer in this app).
# 10049 — Storable and Cacheable Content (Informational).
# Demo app; the cacheability of static assets / order JSON is not a security
# finding worth a per-response Cache-Control policy here.
# 10109 — Modern Web Application (Informational).
# Purely informational ZAP note that the target is a JS-driven SPA-style page;
# not a vulnerability.
# 10055 — CSP analysis (e.g. style-src 'unsafe-inline').
# The CSP keeps 'unsafe-inline' for style-src ONLY (jQuery sets element styles at
# runtime). script-src carries NO inline allowance — the high-value protection
# (no inline/eval script execution) is intact. Accepting the weaker style-src is
# a deliberate trade-off for jQuery compatibility on this demo frontend.
